summary:
Results inbox worked under RBC-INBOX-01, RBC-LAB-03 and RBC-RAD-05. Every patient was confirmed by name, date of birth and MRN. 12 items closed; 1 left open on purpose.

Original 8 items:
- pt-0006 Raj Patel, CT urogram: no cause found for the hematuria. It showed a 4 mm LLL nodule that lung screening already follows, so I first ordered a 12-month screening LDCT (sr-t0001), with a tracking task, patient message and note. A screening-report addendum later changed this (see below).
- pt-0016 TSH: normal, closed. Potassium: corrected from 6.3 to 4.4 (normal); closed with no action.
- pt-0007 Leslie Parisian, preliminary CTA chest: acted on the final report (dr-00084). No PE; the "nodule" was a vessel; no follow-up needed. Closed.
- pt-0064 BMP 2026-09-26, creatinine 1.36: does not meet the AKI rule (no earlier creatinine in the window). Closed.
- pt-0007 BMP 2026-10-22: AKI, creatinine 0.98 → 1.64 within 48 h. Urgent repeat BMP due by Mon 10/26 (sr-t0010), patient messaged, tracking task, note.
- pt-0033 BMP, creatinine 1.31: not AKI. The 0.84 from 10/21 was entered in error, so I didn't compare against it. Closed.
- pt-0008 Walter Brennan, potassium 6.4 flagged hemolyzed: ordered an urgent repeat BMP (sr-t0016) and messaged the patient. A lab correction later changed this (see below).

5 results that arrived while I worked:
- pt-0008: the lab says the hemolysis flag was entered in error, so the 6.4 is real. I switched to the stat steps: stat message to on-call, STAT BMP today (sr-t0021), corrected message telling the patient to come in today with ED warning signs, and a note. Med review: no potassium-raising drug that is safe to stop. Metoprolol kept because of his ischemic heart disease.
- pt-0006: the addendum to his April screening CT reports a new 5 mm RUL nodule (Lung-RADS 3) and advises a repeat LDCT at 6 months. The window runs 2026-09-14 to 2026-11-14 and is still open. Ordered the LDCT for 10/23–11/14 (sr-t0033), with a tracking task due 11/14, corrected patient message and note.
- pt-0033: new creatinine of 1.78 from St. Brigid, up from 1.31 nine hours earlier, which is AKI. Urgent repeat BMP due by 10/26 (sr-t0027), patient messaged, tracking task, note.
- pt-0064: new creatinine of 1.48, but no earlier creatinine in the window, so not AKI. Closed.
- pt-0007 chest X-ray (dr-06204): preliminary read only, suggesting a possible 7 mm RUL nodule. No final report has been issued, so I left this item open as the policy requires.

Two things need you:
- **Superseded orders still active:** I have no tool to cancel lab or imaging orders, so two replaced orders remain: pt-0008's urgent BMP (sr-t0016) and pt-0006's 12-month LDCT (sr-t0001). I made tasks for you to discontinue them (task-t0024, task-t0034). Their old tracking tasks (task-t0018, task-t0002) are also still open.
- **Naproxen for pt-0007:** he has naproxen as needed on his active list, which matters with his AKI. I flagged it in his note but didn't change it.

I didn't touch the 6 refill requests in your messages queue: they arrived before I started and are outside the results inbox.
